title: CEEPUS Exchange Programme
degree: Varies by network (undergraduate, master's or doctoral level, following the sending institution's programme)
duration: 3 to 10 months of exchange within a CEEPUS network
description: CEEPUS is a multilateral exchange programme with Central and Eastern Europe, organised as a transnational university network of subject-specific networks, each containing at least three higher education institutions from at least two different CEEPUS contractual countries. Exchanges last 3 to 10 months. Within a network, incoming students are exempted from paying tuition fees and receive a comprehensive grant from the host country sized according to local living costs. Eligibility requires CEEPUS-country nationality and participation through a member institution.

title: SAF Merit Scholarship
program_type: Military undergraduate scholarship for SAF officer cadets
duration: Sponsorship for up to 6 years of studies, inclusive of a Master's if applicable; FAQ states a stipulated study period of four years
description: The SAF Merit Scholarship is a top-tier military scholarship offered by MINDEF/SAF to Singapore citizens and permanent residents intending to take up citizenship. It pays full tuition fees and other approved academic charges, a monthly salary for the duration of studies, maintenance and other allowances, return airfare and a one-time sponsorship for summer exchange programmes, and can sponsor up to six years of studies inclusive of a Master's degree. Recipients must qualify for and excel in Officer Cadet School and serve a six-year bond in MINDEF/SAF after graduation.

description: The MHA Civilian Scholarship is offered by the Ministry of Home Affairs to Singapore citizens and permanent residents for a civilian appointment in the Home Team, with Generalist and Specialist tracks in Commercial Affairs, Intelligence, Internal Security and Psychology. It covers tuition fees and other approved charges, a monthly overseas or local maintenance allowance including accommodation, a pre-studies allowance, and return economy class airfare for selected tiers.
